cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the first wobble in our baking video. The cake collapsing is the planned turning point; don't cut its setup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored me when I said it was leaning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That warning needs to stay too. Please put it before the close-up; viewers must see why the collapse matters.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no cake left to film for the ending.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Film the empty stand for five seconds. Use your earlier warning as the last sound, then cut to black.
